rejectionReason: The workflow does not retain a canonical candidate identity or run marker in its draft issue, so historical runs with null case and event cannot be assigned to a unique opportunity and no direct attainment metric can be replayed deterministically.

decisions.selected: Assess adoption of the centralized workflow, shared prompt, or playbook proposed for one mined candidate.
alternatives: Count creation of a draft issue
Score agent evaluations or AI-credit estimates
decisions.rationale: The adoption workflow asks for a concrete reviewable draft to reduce repeated prompting; an issue or evaluation is an output or activity, not the intended repository outcome.
The candidate is the unit for which a centralized artifact could be adopted, but the workflow does not persist a canonical candidate identifier.

decisions.selected: Blocked: null case and event cannot reconstruct a unique candidate.
alternatives: Match issue titles by the configured prefix
decisions.rationale: Candidate titles are normalized only in temporary runner files, and draft issue titles have no required candidate or run marker; either alternative can match multiple opportunities.

decisions.selected: Reject issue creation as the primary evidence.
alternatives: A merged centralized artifact linked to the canonical candidate
decisions.rationale: The workflow only creates a draft issue and does not define a repository record that links a candidate to later adoption evidence.
The workflow was added in its adoption commit and its first parent contains no comparable drilldown outcome record.

uncertainties.description: Historical replay provides null case and event, while dispatch inputs and normalized candidate data exist only in temporary runner files.
The created issue does not require a canonical candidate identifier or a link to subsequent artifact adoption.
No pre-adoption workflow or equivalent outcome record exists for comparable scoring.
